chapter_title: Lab: Systems Tour and Minimal Trainer
course_outline_concepts: Read one small trainer end-to-end (TRL SFTTrainer) and map code to Track-1 concepts
Identify the 3 places in the trainer most likely to fail silently
Produce a reproducible multi-GPU run with FSDP + bf16 + packed SFT + response-only masking
Validate masking with a unit test (prompt-token gradient = 0)
Author a failure-mode checklist enumerating instrumented and to-instrument metrics
Resource-constrained path: single-GPU 125M-on-CPU-feasible-data; DDP or FSDP-1-node; memo unchanged

reference_trainer.name: TRL SFTTrainer
reference_trainer.why: Smallest end-to-end SFT reference; cited in ch-04 via hf-alignment-handbook; integrates packing, response-only masking, FSDP/Accelerate, bf16, cosine + warmup, grad clipping in a single class.

sources.what_to_extract: SFTConfig knobs (packing=True, max_seq_length, train_on_response_only); Zephyr-7B reference hparams; FSDP FULL_SHARD + bf16 defaults; 'verify chat template by decoding a packed batch' rule.
Tülu 3 open-instruct trainer numbers at 8B/70B; 2-epoch rule; packing 2.5x throughput with no quality delta; data decontamination as a silent-failure boundary.
Overfit-one-batch discipline; lab-memo tradition; 'neural net training fails silently' — the rationale for the whole chapter.
FSDP FULL_SHARD recipe ingredients; auto_wrap_policy per LlamaDecoderLayer; MixedPrecision config; why clip_grad_norm_ must be the FSDP method not the per-param one.
cu_seqlens, position_ids reset per sub-sequence, flash_attn_varlen_func; cross-contamination unit test idea (toggle mask, measure loss delta).
Response-only loss (labels = -100 on prompt tokens); multi-turn masking rule; the canonical unit test: set prompt label to -100, assert prompt-token gradient is exactly zero.
bf16 default; keep LayerNorm/RMSNorm and softmax in fp32; log loss in fp32.
max_grad_norm = 1.0; FSDP.clip_grad_norm_ vs local; unscale-before-clip ordering.
Cosine with 3% warmup as the lab default; why constant LR is acceptable for a sanity run.
Reference 2025 SFT throughput numbers and post-training recipe scale (SFT budget ~0.1-1% of pretraining); OLMo-Instruct as a target benchmark.

deliverables: figures/trainer-map.html (self-contained interactive call-graph of TRL SFTTrainer)
hard_rules: No CDN references in HTML (inline CSS/JS only)
Quote real API surface from raw-data sources; label inferred defaults when not attested
